readout.notes: Author shim torchcast_shim.py (stdlib only) calls vLLM POST /v1/chat/completions with logprobs=true, top_logprobs=20 (SHIM_TOP_LOGPROBS) and chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking=false, sums option-letter probability mass at the answer slot, applies readout_config.json temperatures (choice 1.0, score 1.0, noul 0.2). OpenAI-style chat logprobs; llama.cpp parity not verified and MLX (mlx_lm.server) not checked, so backend_agnostic is false.
readout.portable_notes: No portable variant: the pinned shim requires vLLM structured_outputs choice masking and chat_template_kwargs in addition to standard logprobs, so an arbitrary OpenAI endpoint does not preserve the readout. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Torchcast-AI/torchcast-decision-12b/d7f84468f7c4a21c8aeed52df845d98c59afae04/serving/torchcast_shim.py L294: "top_logprobs": TOP_LOGPROBS,; L295: "chat_template_kwargs": CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS,; L296: "structured_outputs": {"choice": allowed_letters},
